PhotoConfig.description:
Photo-reaction settings (`[network.reactions.photo]`).

The same keys appear in the global `[network.reactions.photo]` table and
in a reaction's own `[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>".photo]`
table.  A key left out of a reaction's table takes the global value; a key
left out of the global table takes its default: `pi_database = "norad"`,
`override_custom_rate = false`, `override_custom_cross_section = false`,
`use_proxy_photoreaction = true` and no `shielding`.

override_custom_rate.description: Replace a reaction's `.jfunc` `chemRateCoeff<N>` rate with one computed from its cross section over the radiation bands.  Has no effect without a `[network.radiation]` table: the `chemRateCoeff` is then always kept.
override_custom_rate.title: Override Custom Rate

override_custom_cross_section.description: Ignore a reaction's `.jfunc` `photoCrossSection<N>` and take its cross section from the database.  The global value only applies with a `[network.radiation]` table; a value in a reaction's own table applies with or without one.
override_custom_cross_section.title: Override Custom Cross Section

use_proxy_photoreaction.description: Look cross sections up under the proxy reaction (`CHx` → `CH`).
use_proxy_photoreaction.title: Use Proxy Photoreaction

shielding.description: Line shielding of the rate; without it, the rate is not shielded.

PhotoConfig.title: PhotoConfig

threshold_low.description: Lower edge of the photoelectric band in eV (grain work function).
threshold_low.title: Threshold Low

threshold_high.description: Upper edge of the photoelectric band in eV, above `threshold_low`.
threshold_high.title: Threshold High

RadiationConfig.description:
Radiation field (`[network.radiation]`); the table enables radiation.

Only the shape of the settings is checked here; whether the band-averaged
spectrum converges is checked by the radiation field itself.

bands.description: Increasing photon-energy band edges in eV, at least two; `"inf"` is allowed as the last edge only.
bands.title: Bands

profile_index.description: Spectral index *α* of the photon-number spectrum `n(E) ∝ E^(α-2)`: one for every band, or a list with one per band.
profile_index.title: Profile Index

mode.description: Tracked quantity: `"nph"` (photon number density) or `"u"` (energy density).
mode.title: Mode

c.description: Speed of light in cm/s, or a symbol name (e.g. `"c_hat"`) for a reduced speed of light.
c.title: C

background_field.description: Reference radiation field used to scale `chi_pe`.
background_field.title: Background Field

absorption_attenuates_flux.description: Whether the `globalAbsorptionCoefficient` also attenuates the flux equations, not only the density equations.
absorption_attenuates_flux.title: Absorption Attenuates Flux

emissivity.description: Emission sources, each `{ type = "<plugin>", ... }`: a volume emissivity spectrum in `ph_E` (erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹ eV⁻¹).  Their spectra are summed with the `.jfunc` `globalEmissivity` and integrated over each band; an entry repeating another exactly (same type and settings) is rejected.  Empty by default.
emissivity.title: Emissivity

absorption_coefficient.description: Absorbers, each `{ type = "<plugin>", ... }`: an absorption coefficient spectrum in `ph_E` (cm⁻¹).  Their spectra are summed with the `.jfunc` `globalAbsorptionCoefficient` and averaged over each band; an entry repeating another exactly is rejected.  Empty by default.
absorption_coefficient.title: Absorption Coefficient

RadiationConfig.title: RadiationConfig

ReactionConfig.description:
Settings of one reaction (`[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>"]`).

`None` means unset: the value comes from the global settings.

duplicate_policy.description: How two rate coefficients over the same temperature range are resolved: `"preserve-first"`, `"preserve-last"` or `"error"`.
duplicate_policy.title: Duplicate Policy

t_cutoff.description: Rate outside the temperature range: `"clip"` holds the value at the nearest limit, `"extrapolate"` extends the outermost formulas and `"zero"` makes the rate 0 below the lowest and above the highest limit (KROME's behaviour).  A gap between two ranges is interpolated in every mode.
t_cutoff.title: T Cutoff

thermodynamics.description: Thermodynamic settings of this reaction only (`energy_change`); there is no `[network.reactions]` default.

ReactionConfig.title: ReactionConfig

ReactionThermodynamicsConfig.description: Thermodynamic settings of one reaction (its `thermodynamics` table).

energy_change.description: The energy-change plugin of the reaction (`{ type = "<plugin>", ... }`): the energy one event adds to the gas (erg; negative cools).  A `.jfunc` `deltaE<N>` takes preference over it.

ReactionThermodynamicsConfig.title: ReactionThermodynamicsConfig

ReactionsConfig.description:
Settings of the reactions (`[network.reactions]`).

Each key applies to every reaction, unless a reaction's own table
(`reaction."<serialized>"`) sets it.

duplicate_policy.description: How two rate coefficients over the same temperature range are resolved: `"preserve-first"`, `"preserve-last"` or `"error"`.
duplicate_policy.title: Duplicate Policy

t_cutoff.description: Rate outside the temperature range: `"clip"` holds the value at the nearest limit, `"extrapolate"` extends the outermost formulas and `"zero"` makes the rate 0 below the lowest and above the highest limit (KROME's behaviour).  A gap between two ranges is interpolated in every mode.
t_cutoff.title: T Cutoff

reaction.description: Per-reaction settings keyed by serialized reaction; a key set there wins over the same key here.
reaction.title: Reaction

ReactionsConfig.title: ReactionsConfig

min_ncol.description: Floor on the dimensionless column `x = N(H2) / 5e14 cm^-2` of the fit (a floor on `x`, not on the column density in cm^-2).

min_vdisp.description: Floor on the dimensionless Doppler parameter `b5 = sqrt(2) * vdisp / 1e5 cm/s` of the fit (a floor on `b5`, not on the velocity dispersion in cm/s); keeps `x / b5` finite when `vdisp` is 0.
min_vdisp.title: Min Vdisp

shielded_by.description: Shielding species, `"self"` being the reaction's own reactant; their factors multiply.
shielded_by.title: Shielded By

radiation.description: Radiation field the shielding factors were computed for: the name of a subgroup of the reaction's group in the shipped `leiden.hdf5` (case-insensitive).  Every reaction has `"isrf"` (the default), `"bb-4000"`, `"bb-10000"`, `"bb-20000"`, `"ly-alpha"`, `"solar"` and `"tw-hya"`; all but `"Zn._PHOTON__Zn+.e-"` have `"mathis-1983"`; only `"HF._PHOTON__F.H"` and `"HF._PHOTON__HF+.e-"` have `"gondhalekar-1980"` and `"habing-1968"`.  Some subgroups lack some species (`"ly-alpha"` is empty for 84 of the 149 reactions).  The value is not checked when the config is read: a missing subgroup fails when the shielding table is read from `leiden.hdf5`.
radiation.title: Radiation

ShieldingConfig.description: Line shielding of a photo reaction; `type` selects the model (default 'leiden') and its keys.
ShieldingConfig.title: Shielding

eos.description: Equation of state; its `type` selects the model and its keys.

heating_cooling_rate.description: Global heating/cooling mechanisms, each `{ type = "<plugin>", ... }` (erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹; negative cools).  Their rates are summed and added to the `.jfunc` `heatingCoolingRate`; an entry repeating another exactly (same type and settings) is rejected.  Empty by default.
heating_cooling_rate.title: Heating Cooling Rate
